evidence.code_or_bytecode: BNB Smart Chain latest-state runtime bytecode: 20240 bytes; keccak256 0x162b6e63cc0f75d55e6cd1d80c9325385a43896a031c910673377f13fa179bba. Official archived lottery repository commit d2ebe90700f842bd62280e0ecc7bb95c2475f2c4 documents the VRF request/callback pattern.
evidence.abi_calldata: abi_fragment.json records closeLottery, drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable and LotteryNumberDrawn from the verified v2 contract ABI.
evidence.randomness: Official documentation states Lottery uses Chainlink VRF. The archived official implementation requests randomness and accepts the result only through the random-generator callback.
evidence.payoff: LotteryNumberDrawn records finalNumber and winning-ticket count; ticket claims distribute CAKE according to matching brackets.
evidence.events_traces_storage: BscScan labels the deployed contract and exposes LotteryClose, LotteryNumberDrawn, TicketsPurchase and TicketsClaim events. Example VRF request transaction: 0x717fc63d364c0b5e75d40ba13712abc08ec9c6c5ba7d0762703523cbfdcceafd.

notes: Catalog-only safe reference. No local VRF mock is treated as real VRF evidence.
